title: Cap and Sylvester go to New Orleans; Julius invited to play the lakefront
summary: Cap started on clarinet, joined other bands and led his own; Sylvester followed; they brought Julius, still young, to play.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yes, they had the other people, uh, I mean the people over there, they would, uh, follow behind my dad and his little band over there. Oh, I can't call some of the other people, that guy from over here that played with him. And, Cap, he was, just as started on clarinet. And, he come over here with Tom Albert. And, that's when he began to get with Tuck Johnson and other bands. I can't call all the names because some I know and some I don't know. And, then he finally, he got his own band. They called it the Haines, Louisiana Shakers. And, he just used to shake all over the city. Yeah, he was a great guy. He just carried everything on. So, finally, uh, Sebastian came over and he went to playing with the Tuxedas and, uh, oh, I don't know how many bands that he has played with. And, then they began to come and get me and bring me out to the Levita to Budweiser. You were still really young. I was still young then. And, they used to come and get me the nights that I wasn't playing. Well, the nights that I was playing, I was out with the real people, with the rich people. They had their parties at their own houses. And, uh, every week I had my engagements from this place to that place.
Well, you couldn't have been that young.
Well, uh, I mean, that's after I came over here.
Well, when they came to the coast they got to you, what was your age?
